newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fukoku Life says wary of foreign investments.
newsitem.headline: Fukoku Life says wary of foreign investments.

text.p: Fukoku Mutual Life Insurance Co said on Tuesday it was wary of aggressively investing in instruments denominated in foreign currencies, given the current volatile currency markets.
The company said it will monitor market trends and may invest in domestic stocks and real estate if conditions allow.
If current trends do not change, the company is likely to invest in government and corporate bonds, he added.
The company held 7.8 billion yen worth of bad loans and problem loans at the end of March, versus total assets of 4.1283 trillion yen, he said.
The levels at which unrealised profits on its stock holdings would fall to zero are 14,200 in the Nikkei stock average and 1,080 in the TOPIX index, he added.
